candidates.summary: altitude: BuildPlan knows exactly which realms it appended as gnoweb seeds and records nothing, so comment.go re-derives it by matching the global list — and in mode "both" an affected realm that is also a seed is rendered, crawled and linked nowhere
candidates.failure_scenario: A PR that touches gno.land/pkg/gnoweb/ and a package imported by gno.land/r/gnoland/home gets Mode() == "both". Comment() takes the default branch, which lists ChangedRealms and then every realm that is !direct[r] && !isSeed(r, p); isSeed matches gnowebSeedRealms, so gnoland/home is dropped from the indirect list even though it entered Plan.Realms as a genuinely affected realm, not as a seed. The seed branch that would have listed it only runs in mode "gnoweb". The realm is booted in gnodev, crawled and written into the snapshot, and no link in the comment reaches it. The deeper form is for BuildPlan to record what it appended (a Seeds field, or a per-realm reason) instead of comment.go guessing from a package-level list; the shallow form costs a silent misclassification every time a seed realm is also affected.
